messages:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 5xx rate from inference-gateway (service: inference-gateway.prod). Current 5m error-rate = 4.6% (SLO target 0.5%). paging oncall team now. Incident ID: INC-2026-058. Links: https://ops.redwood/INC-2026-058 , grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/ingress/errors?orgId=1
Oncall Bot: Paging: @Alex C (oncall) -> escalation to SRE Lead if not ack in 5m :rotating_light:
Alex C: acked. looking. seeing gateway 502/504s and some upstream timeouts to model-router. no obvious deploys in last 30m. checking logs and recent routing changes.
Alex C: quick snapshot: 3k requests/min, CPU on inference-gateway pods stable, but model-router p99 latency jumped and responds with 502. suspect upstream provider (edge-proxy) errors.
Maria P: I can shadow. customer impact: a couple of customers on dedicated pools reported retries and client-side timeouts. Not platform-wide but high-volume routes hit.
Jason L: adding logs from one pod: 
```
2026-03-07T14:12:31Z ERROR upstream request failed: status=502 host=model-router-2:8080 err="timeout after 6s"
2026-03-07T14:12:34Z ERROR kvcache miss and retry -> upstream 504
```
Alex C: mitigation plan: 1) scale model-router replicas x2, 2) enable fallback routing to smaller model-variant for affected routes, 3) short-circuit some heavy routes to cached responses. doing step 1 now.
SRE Lead: good. prioritize scaling + fallback. notify infra if autoscaler isn't catching it. also create temporary slack alert to reduce paging noise while we mitigate.
Tara N: scaled model-router from 6 -> 12 replicas, pods healthy. p95 latency improving slightly.
Alex C: toggled fallback routing for high-volume /generate routes -> traffic offloaded to model-compact-1. error-rate dropped to 2.1% in last 2m. still above SLO but improving.
Maria P: starting customer outreach for top 3 impacted accounts. cc: support.
Jason L: created a short Grafana panel showing per-route 5xx and upstream host breakdown: https://grafana/redwood/d/ingress/per-route-errors?panel=4
Alex C: we need to address alert noise: current alert fires when 5xx > 1% for 5m which caused large pages during transient upstream bursts. propose: change alert to require both 5xx > 2% and sustained >10m OR cardinality of affected routes > 3. thoughts?
SRE Lead: agree. we should also create a secondary warning-level alert (no page) at 1% for 5m and keep page threshold at 3% for 10m. That reduces noise but still catches production issues. File ticket to update rule + runbook.
Maria P: please include guidance in runbook for immediate mitigations: scale model-router, enable fallback, add upstream host to blocklist if one host misbehaves, temp increase client retry backoff.
Alex C: drafting Prometheus rule snippet for discussion:
```
- alert: InferenceGatewayHigh5xx
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway"}[5m])) > 0.03
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://ops.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx
```
Alex C: also adding non-paging warning rule:
```
- alert: InferenceGateway5xxWarning
  expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway"}[5m])) ) > 0.01
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```
Tara N: fine with that. Would also like route-cardinality gating: if only a single route spikes (eg /bulk-export) we don't page. we can add `count by (route) (rate(...))` condition.
SRE Lead: action items: 1) Alex -> open INF-1234 to update alerting rules and attach proposed snippets (due EOD). 2) Maria -> update runbook with mitigation steps and customer comms template (due today). 3) Jason -> add per-route breakdown dashboard and short-term alert suppression for known noisy routes (due 2 hours). 4) Tara -> follow up on autoscaler config to prevent cold-start saturation (due tomorrow).
Alex C: INF-1234 created: https://jira.redwood/browse/INF-1234. assigning to SRE Oncall and monitoring for 24h. adding postmortem label.
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-058 status: mitigated -> reduced 5xx to ~0.6% after mitigations; monitoring in recovery window.
Maria P: handing off follow-up to @Tara N for autoscaler review and @Jason L for dashboards. I'll continue customer comms until close. passing to next oncall at 15:00 UTC.
Tara N: ack. I'll own autoscaler + runbook PRs.
SRE Lead: nice work. after action: we should tune the alert thresholds and add more context in alert messages (per-route top hosts) to speed triage. add retrospective notes to INF-1234. :thumbsup:
Alex C: filing a short post-incident note in #postmortems and linking INF-1234. closing thread when follow-ups are complete. 
Incident Bot: INC-2026-058 -> status: monitoring. last update 2350008699.
